name: Deadman's Wonder
source:
Journey down the rabbit hole into a Wonderland like you've never seen before~. Embark on a TwIsTeD retelling of the classic fairy tale "Alice in Wonderland".


Join Alice in this visual novel experience as you both try to survive this hellscape and unravel the mystery of who you are and what happened to the citizens of Wonderland.

Meet a colorful cast of characters while embarking through the woods!! You never know who is truly on your side. Maybe everyone or no one at all?

It's a long journey to the Hearts Palace... Can you survive long enough???

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
沿着兔子洞进入你从未见过的仙境~。踏上扭曲重述经典童话故事“爱丽丝梦游仙境”的旅程。


与爱丽丝一起体验这个视觉小说体验，你们都试图在这个地狱般的环境中生存，并解开你是谁以及仙境公民发生了什么的谜团。

穿过树林时遇到色彩缤纷的角色！你永远不知道谁是真正站在你这一边的。也许每个人都或者根本没有人？

前往红心宫殿的旅程很漫长……你能活得足够长吗？？？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520770/]Steam[/url]]
